items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: Walter Hamilton. That judge himself. He used to play there.

ctx.x: See, I can blow them. Yeah, I know. But I know fellas them days to make music out and you could dance by them. I know a white fella today. I don't believe he died in Hamilton, huh? Hamilton. Hamilton. Walter Hamilton. That judge himself. He used to play there.
He'd come up down my way.
